input.topic: KnowledgeDeliver LMS ViewState deserialization zero-day exploitation (CVE-2026-5426), 2025-2026
input.notes: Manual intake from Risky Bulletin dated 2026-05-27. Google/Mandiant reports late-2025 incident response where an unknown actor exploited KnowledgeDeliver's shared ASP.NET machineKey / ViewState deserialization flaw as a zero-day, injected malicious JavaScript into LMS portals, and attempted to infect visitors. Scope as zero-day exploitation of KnowledgeDeliver LMS CVE-2026-5426, not generic ASP.NET ViewState coverage. Use Google/Mandiant as the primary technical source; Risky Bulletin is discovery/context only. Drafting worker should confirm vendor patch/disclosure details and avoid claiming broader exploitation beyond source-supported KnowledgeDeliver installations.
